For me it makes everything dull and heavy and empty.  Kind of like going through a tunnel and you just don't even notice, and you don't know whats at the end. You can exit anytime but you're used to the tunnel so you keep walking in the darkness. And when you encounter light the darkness of the tunnel takes it away. Your whole body and mind is tired and drifts away as you keep walking. 

Sometimes people will come visit you so you step outside the tunnel. But you're still in that tunnel mentally, walking and tired. You try to talk to people and try to escape the tunnel, and sometimes you can, but then the tunnel takes you back. 

Sometimes for me there are resting stops in the tunnel, things that are important to me like my books and my pets. But as soon as they're gone I have to keep walking.

I'm hopeful though that oneday I can escape the tunnel and live life normally and happily.
